narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.16 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1431-0.1463 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.1473; the first objective pays 0.74R at 0.1421.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.1431-0.1463
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1473 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 32/100 — trend broken, ask-wall ceiling
